description:
## Problem
`_fold_layout_operations_into_ledger` (`benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:1487-1512`) maps every non-"applied" op to `STATEMENT_FAILED`. Databricks records deliberate Hudi and Delta-only skips as status "skipped" (`databricks/adapter.py:2489-2496, 3640-3700`), so intentional skips can flip the run to `failed`.

Databricks also emits phase `"pre_load"`. `overall_status` filters physical statements by `{ddl, post_load}` (`applied_ledger.py:291`), so those statements escape the all-failed check, and `record()` never validates phase.

## Change (per the D-6 decision)
- Mapping: `applied` → executed; `failed` → failed; `skipped` → `record_dropped(statement, reason)`; anything else → failed, logged.
- `record()` normalizes phases to the decided closed set.
- Map Databricks `pre_load` per the decision. After the post-load seam lands, its OPTIMIZE becomes `post_load`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Skips still block `applied_verified`, as drops.
- Real failures still record as failed.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
